notes.title: V0.4.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
Dear community members,

during the last few days, our team made several content update to the game:

1. a new boss: KYLIE THE LIGHTNING STAR is added
2. 2 new skills: Bubble Gun & Ghost Wolf are added to the game. 
3. Multiple boss challenge option has been added to endless mode, player now can fight multiple bosses at the same time.
4. a new mechanics: destiny portal has been added. Player can now choose between two different portals. Prepare for the randomness!

this update also comes with some ui/ux update and bugfix. 

Wish everyone a merry Christmas and a happy new year!

notes.title: V0.3.3 Patch Note
notes.content:
1. We fully examined the performance issue and greatly enhanced the frame rate when a large amount of enemies exist on the battlefield. The game now much smoother under such occasions. We will continue to tackle this problem and provide a more consistent gameplay. **

2.  Fixed some art-related issues and some UI display issues.

3. Made some tiny balancing changes.

4. We created a new branch and player can access it under properties section. In that branch, we will publish some new content for testing in order to ensure the stability of the main branch.

notes.title: V0.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1. Added in a brand new mini-map feature (M on keyboard and R1 on joystick). 
2. Fixed a bug where game freezes when leveled up
3. Fixed the incorrect slow down behavior of ice spray.
4. Fixed several UI display issues.

We really appreciate all the feedback and bug reports!

notes.title: V0.3.1+ Patch Note
notes.content:
-Fix Ability: Ice Spray's damage calculation
-Improve Ability: Floral Sea's performance
-Fix the player's teleport position when entering the battleground
-Fix losing focus when opening the game
-Fix the UI of ability panel

notes.title: V0.3.1+ Patch Notes
notes.content:
Following the previous update, we made some more minor changes:

1. Fixed a problem where player still deal damage after death lol. 
2. Fixed the incorrect display of the level indicator sign.
3. Again, we tried to improve the performance issue. We will continue to work on this problem and sorry for any inconvenience it might have caused.

notes.title: V0.3.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixes:
1. Fixed a problem where Fish will disappear
2. Fixed the leader board display problem
3. Fixed a problem where customized settings reset when player re-open the game
Updates:
1. Attempted to enhance the performance issue
2. Now the game supports controllers (also playable on steam deck)

p.s. If you experience lagging issue, we suggest you turn off damage display in the settings menu. At the same time, floral sea can hurt the performance badly sometimes and we are investigating this issue. Thanks for your patience and we apologize for any bad experience you might have.

notes.title: V0.3.0 Patch Note
notes.content:
1. Fixed a problem where sometimes player could not summon boss
2. Fixed a problem where panels do not go away in game
3. Now you can properly add rounds and venture deeper into the woods after beating the final boss
4. Elite is now more aggressive around players.
4. Improved many UI/UX issues

Our team values your experience very much, and we will continue to make the game better.

notes.title: V0.2.8 Patch Note
notes.content:
1. Fixed a issue where sometimes start screen UI becomes unresponsive 
2. Fixed leader board display issue

Hope all of you could have fun in this game!
